description:
Current SII scores (0-100) for scored stablecoins. Use before any decision involving stablecoins.

    Parameters:
        limit: max coins returned (default 25, max 500)
        fields: columns to return per coin (default id, symbol, name, issuer,
            score, grade, confidence, stale, computed_at); name "categories"
            for category scores
        sort_by: "score_desc" (default), "score_asc", or "symbol"

    One coin's detail: entity_read(query).
name: get_stablecoin_scores
